description.zh: 演练ID。您可以通过[DescribePairDrills](~~2584480~~)接口查询当前地域下复制对的容灾演练。
description.en: The ID of the drill. You can call the [DescribePairDrills](~~2584480~~) operation to query the disaster recovery drills that were performed on replication pairs in a specific region.

description.zh: 复制对ID。您可以调用[DescribeDiskReplicaPairs](~~354206~~)查询异步复制对列表，获得复制对ID。
description.en: The ID of the replication pair. You can call the [DescribeDiskReplicaPairs](~~354206~~) operation to query the most recent list of replication pairs, including replication pair IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~354276~~)查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) operation to query the most recent list of regions in which async replication is supported.

title.zh: 清理异步复制对的容灾演练

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs clear-pair-drill --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pair-id pair-xxxx --drill-id drill-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
